    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"

>
[Dire Growth](/Feats.aspx?ID=5503) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=676" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 78

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); your animal shape is not Small

</column>

---

You transform into a primal reflection of your animal shape. If you aren't already in your animal shape from Werecreature Dedication, you Change Shape into it. As long as you stay in animal shape, you have the effects of [_enlarge_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1514).
name: Dire Growth
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape is not Small
